narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A straight line is not an angle, so no straight angle appears in the figures.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Look at the flat fan. One arm has turned half of a full turn about the vertex.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A turn about a vertex is an angle, so a straight angle is an angle too.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check each angle, lay a square paper corner on it. See if the angle is smaller or bigger.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>If the arms lie in one line, the angle is a straight angle.
